title: The Hustle – Email Marketing, Lead Generation, Optins, Popups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site…
description: The Hustle WordPress plugin, used for email marketing and lead generation, contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'import_file' parameter affecting all versions up to 7.8.14.4. This vulnerability allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts if the administrator has delegated the 'hustle_edit_module' capability to lower-privileged roles. Without such delegation, non-administrator users are blocked from exploiting this issue.
